I wrote `main.rs` with a `Shape` trait (`name`, `corners`, `double_area`) and one struct that implements it for all four shape types. I compiled it and ran Example 1, and the output matched. I didn't run Example 2 or the no-shapes case (`largest=none`).

It uses `u128` for the areas, so products and the total of 64-bit inputs won't overflow. The first shape with the largest double area wins ties,
